COMMONWEALTH OF VIRGINIA
SUMMONS FOR UNLAWFUL DETAINER (CIVIL CLAIM FOR EVICTION)
Richmond General District Court, Case No. GV26-004182
Plaintiff: Oakline Property Management LLC
Defendant: Tenant(s) and all other occupants
TO THE DEFENDANT: You are hereby summoned to appear before this Court on the return date below to answer the Plaintiff's claim for possession of the premises and unpaid rent of $2,900.00. Return date: November 12, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. If you fail to appear, judgment may be entered against you for possession, rent, damages, and attorney's fees, and a writ of possession may issue.

20. DEFAULT. If Tenant fails to pay rent within five days after written notice, Landlord may terminate this Agreement and file an unlawful detainer action in the General District Court to recover possession, as permitted by the Virginia Residential Landlord and Tenant Act.
14. LOCKS. Tenant shall not change or add locks without Landlord's written consent. Landlord will rekey the locks at no charge on request of a tenant who presents a protective order.
9. UTILITIES. Landlord shall supply running water and reasonable amounts of hot water and heat at all times, except where the building is not equipped for them. Tenant pays electricity and gas.
4. SECURITY DEPOSIT. Tenant has paid a security deposit of $1,450.00. Landlord will return the deposit, less lawful deductions itemized in writing, within 45 days after the tenancy ends.
17. PETS. One cat or dog under 30 pounds is permitted with a $300 pet deposit. Service animals and assistance animals are not pets and are not subject to this section.
20. INCUMPLIMIENTO. Si el Inquilino no paga la renta, el Arrendador podrá iniciar un proceso de desalojo conforme a la ley de Virginia.
3. RENTA. El Inquilino pagará la renta el día 1 de cada mes. Se cobrará un cargo por mora de $50 después del día 5.
12. ACCESO. El Arrendador podrá entrar a la vivienda con aviso de 24 horas para hacer reparaciones o mostrarla.

FIVE-DAY NOTICE FOR NONPAYMENT OF RENT
Date: November 3, 2026
To: [TENANT_NAME] and all occupants, 1820 Grove Avenue, Apt. 2
Rent of $1,275.00 for November is unpaid. Your tenancy is terminated for nonpayment unless you pay the full amount due within five (5) days of this notice. If you do not pay the balance or surrender possession of the dwelling by that date, the landlord will file for possession in the General District Court and seek a judgment for rent, late fees, and costs.

AVISO DE CINCO DÍAS POR FALTA DE PAGO DE RENTA
Fecha: 3 de noviembre de 2026
Para: [TENANT_NAME] y todos los ocupantes, 1820 Grove Avenue, Apto. 2
La renta de noviembre de $1,275.00 no ha sido pagada. Su contrato de arrendamiento queda terminado por falta de pago. Usted debe pagar el saldo total o entregar la posesión de la vivienda dentro de cinco (5) días a partir de este aviso. De lo contrario, el arrendador presentará una demanda de posesión ante el Tribunal General de Distrito sin más aviso.

21. NONPAYMENT AND SURRENDER. Rent unpaid five days after its due date is late. After written notice as the Virginia Residential Landlord and Tenant Act requires, Landlord may terminate this Lease for nonpayment and may file for possession. At the end of the tenancy, however it ends, Tenant shall surrender possession of the Premises clean and with all keys returned.

21. FALTA DE PAGO Y ENTREGA. La renta no pagada cinco días después de su vencimiento se considera atrasada. Después del aviso por escrito que exige la ley de Virginia, el Arrendador podrá terminar este Contrato por falta de pago y presentar una demanda de posesión. Al terminar el arrendamiento, el Inquilino deberá entregar la posesión de la vivienda limpia y devolver todas las llaves.
